title: Weekly-v1 to v8 Promotion Mapping
description: Defines which fields must be added to promote a weekly-v1 artifact to a full v8 artifact. Promotion is only allowed when all required evidence is present.

offer.description: Fields required to promote weekly-offer to v8 offer

evidence_required.price: Evidence-backed pricing data from positioning audit
evidence_required.total_value_stack: Sum of evidence-backed bonus dollar values plus core offer value

offer.promotion_rule: price and total_value_stack must be present with evidence_citations. evidence_unavailable must be false or absent.

hooks.description: Hooks are already v8-compatible individually; promotion unwraps the array
hooks.promotion_rule: Unwrap array; each hook object already matches v8 hook.schema.json. Add format_variants for top 10 if promoting to full v8.

content-calendar.description: Fields required to promote weekly content-calendar to v8

evidence_required.entries: 30-day content entries with platform, content_type, title, has_proof
evidence_required.proof_density: Fraction of entries with has_proof=true, must be >= 0.50

content-calendar.promotion_rule: Must expand from 7-day to 30-day calendar with full pillars and entries.

funnel-audit.description: Fields required to promote weekly funnel-audit to v8

evidence_required.awareness_audit: Full awareness audit with hook/messaging/proof scores and attention leaks
evidence_required.lead_capture_audit: Full lead capture audit with opt-in/value scores and friction items

funnel-audit.promotion_rule: Must conduct full awareness and lead-capture audit, not just 3 fixes.

proof-library.description: Fields required to promote weekly proof-library to v8

evidence_required.assets: Full proof asset library with short/mid/long formats
evidence_required.proof_stories: At least 20 proof stories with 150-300 word narratives

proof-library.promotion_rule: Must build full asset library and 20+ proof stories with evidence.
